main.description: One account's own consent to appear in elopt: to be named, put up for a battle, and ranked on the public elo board. Singleton (rkey always "self") — writing it opts in, deleting it opts out and immediately drops the account from the roster and every future leaderboard replay. This is the whole consent mechanism: elopt never lists or scores an account that hasn't written this record itself. Written and read by elopt (https://elopt.bisks.net).

consent.description: Always true — the record's mere existence is the opt-in, this field just makes the record self-describing on its own.

createdAt.description: When this account opted in, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
